child.text:
[{"insert":"Low Incline DB Bench Press

The final low incline dumbbell bench session of the cycle. The low incline angle sits just above flat, placing more emphasis on the mid chest while also engaging the upper chest. Reps drop further this week, which means this should be the heaviest dumbbell pressing work of the six weeks. The set still finishes with a max unbroken drop set at Set 1 weight. Aim to beat Week 4 across all working sets.
"}]
